annotations.title: Smart-money flow for a pump.fun token (what proven wallets are doing)

description: For a pump.fun token mint: how many proven wallets (statistically positive past results over the last 30 days, net of estimated fees; creators, launch-block buyers, wash-like and clustered wallets removed) bought or sold it in the last 15 min / 1 h / 24 h, their share of active wallets, net SOL flow, first proven entry time (UTC), whether they are exiting, top proven wallets with an anonymous score band, coverage and confidence. Covers pump.fun bonding-curve (pre-graduation) trades only; never estimated. Informational data only, not financial advice; past wallet performance does not predict results. Free/keyless: headline; full report with any API key, or x402 pay-per-call at $0.01 USDC: GET /v1/x402/smartmoney/{mint}.
